prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. Interior room seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image; keep the outer left and right 7 % of the image as plain dark wall so nothing important sits there. "Netzcafé Datenkrümel", a cramped cheap internet café in the underground metro station of the slums. The large walkable area is a worn checkered floor of black and dull-green vinyl tiles with soda stains, filling the middle and lower part of the room.
TOP WALL (cut-away, seen from above): in the TOP LEFT corner a nook with an ancient huge beige computer tower and a bulky old CRT monitor glowing green, cables spilling out of it like spaghetti, a squeaky office chair - an obvious secret old machine; in the TOP CENTER a cork pinboard covered in scraps of paper, photos and pins (no readable text); in the TOP RIGHT a small counter with a battered coffee vending machine, paper cups, a jar of cookies and a neon coffee-cup symbol.
CENTER LEFT: two long rows of rental computer desks with flickering monitors (blue and green glow, abstract shapes only), gamer headsets, energy drink cans, cheap plastic chairs in front of them.
RIGHT SIDE: a cosy corner table with a sticker-covered laptop, a beanbag and a small desk lamp - the most eye-catching spot, warm pink-violet light.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a crate with tangled cables and a broken router.
BOTTOM CENTER: the glass entrance door (the way out to the station hall), a doormat, cyan light from the hall falling in.
Light: dim indoor light, blue and green monitor glow, pink and violet neon accents, one flickering ceiling tube.
